knowledge.purpose: Responsive multi-column grid that lays out children in evenly distributed columns
useCases: Marketing feature grid (3 or 4 cards across)
antiPatterns: Single-column or simple flex layout — use layout.container
Nested grids as direct children — wrap inner grid in a container first
Tabular data with rows + columns — a grid lays out tiles; it has no header row and no column alignment
knowledge.implementation:
Further use cases:
- Dashboard tile arrangement that reflows on mobile

jsonSchema.description: Columns on a phone (640px and below). Unset = one column. Set 2 for small tiles (stats, shortcuts) that should sit side by side on a phone.
Space between cells: a number of pixels or a CSS length. Unset → the theme grid gap.

props.name: rowGap
props.description: Vertical gap override in px; falls back to `gap`.

props.name: columnGap
props.description: Horizontal gap override in px; falls back to `gap`.

props.name: rows
props.description: Explicit row count for 2D compositions — pairs with honest column tracks so child spans are deterministic.
